review: Independent source review and scratch reproductions; no product edits by reviewer
status: No remaining engine correctness or data-loss blocker found after fixes

findings.initial_problem: Multi-paragraph removal could discard paragraph-owned bookmarks or unrepresented legacy field boundaries.
findings.resolution: Reject bookmarkName/sourceBookmarkName and legacy boundary flags without matching modeled inline boundaries. Represented fields use the complete story scan.
findings.verification: Independent bookmark/source-bookmark/field-end refusals leave all paragraphs and metadata unchanged.

findings.initial_problem: A last paragraph reused in another section was split destructively at both positions, changing unselected OLD suffix to OLD.
findings.resolution: Count selected paragraph identity occurrences across body/container/auxiliary/note/comment stories, under a one-million-occurrence bound, and require exactly one.
findings.verification: Independent shared-end reproduction now refuses and preserves the other section text.

findings.initial_problem: At raw offset zero, multi-paragraph replacement could remove the authored-note separator; leading table insertion could then consume the unselected suffix leading space as the separator.
findings.resolution: Capture an effective insertion offset before joining the suffix, preserving the original reference separator independently.
findings.verification: Footnotes/endnotes with explicit markers retain marker, separator and suffix whitespace with plain, heading and table payloads.

findings.initial_problem: Untouched explicit complex packets at exact prefix/suffix endpoints, and a nonempty citation at last offset zero, were refused where equivalent simple packets could succeed.
findings.resolution: Permit untouched nonempty endpoint packets; retain overlap and zero-width-citation refusal and full-story generic/nested/malformed field checks.
findings.verification: Eight simple/explicit-complex by in-memory/reopened by prefix/suffix reproductions apply successfully with changed-length refreshed fields in correct order. Last-offset-zero simple and complex capability checks accept.

reviewed_guarantees: Descending field application refreshes suffix fields before the splice and prefix fields afterward.
Source/current-range checks repeat before mutation; the controller additionally owns revision, selection, lifecycle and undo/rollback protection.
Suffix markup is moved from the live refreshed paragraph, not reconstructed from captured plain text.
Zero-text citations on consumed boundaries remain guarded because split affinity would otherwise leave their packet in a removed paragraph.

reproduction_runtime.commands: Direct bin/cache/dart-sdk/bin/dart with isolated runtime workspace package configuration

qualification_boundary: These are independently inspected focused reproductions, not additional cases to add to the project acceptance test counts. They do not establish installed Zotero/Word/LibreOffice or cross-platform interoperability.
diagnostics: One concurrent Flutter dart-wrapper engine.stamp race was rerun successfully using the direct Dart SDK binary; not a product failure.
